Hadith.1832 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"When the Month of Ramadan approached, three days before the end of Sha‘ban, He said to Bilal: 'Call the people.'
He (sw) gathered the people, then ascended the pulpit, praised Allah (swt), and glorified Him, and then said:
'
O people, the month has come to you. It is the master of the months. In it is a night that is

During this month, the gates of the Fire are closed, and the gates of Paradise are opened. Whoever attains this month and is not forgiven, may Allah (swt) distance him. Whoever attains his parents and is not forgiven, may Allah (swt) distance him. And whoever hears my name mentioned and does not send blessings upon me, and is not forgiven, may Allah (swt) distance him.'"
